steps.en: Install the framework from source into your Python environment
steps.zh: 从源码把框架装进 Python 环境

steps.en: Register your dataset in the data index
steps.zh: 把数据集登记进数据索引文件

steps.en: Pick model, stage and finetuning_type in one YAML, then launch the CLI
steps.zh: 在一份 YAML 里选好模型、任务与微调方式，一条命令开跑

steps.en: Resolves the model's chat template and runs the job on transformers/peft/trl, accelerators optional
steps.zh: 解析对话模板，在 transformers/peft/trl 上跑训练

value.en: Fine-tune any of 100+ models from one YAML — the same config also runs in the LlamaBoard web UI
value.zh: 一份 YAML 微调 100+ 模型，同一份配置也能在 LlamaBoard 网页里跑
